role: Picks wander/panic/shelter destinations: draws 10 random candidates in an xz/y range, drops candidates against a direction vector, keeps home-radius candidates only, and returns the one with the best block-path weight.

members.name: staticVector
members.note: a shared static cache; the native code passes the direction as arguments instead, which also removes the Java threading hazard

members.name: findRandomTarget
members.note: no direction vector; used by wander, panic and play

members.name: findRandomTargetBlockTowards
members.note: the dot-product >= 0 direction filter; used by moveIndoors, moveThroughVillage, moveTowardsRestriction and moveTowardsTarget

members.name: findRandomTargetBlockAwayFrom
members.note: the vector from the avoided entity to the creature, into random_target_block

members.name: findRandomTargetBlock
members.note: the 10-candidate scan: the home-radius guard, the per-candidate RNG draws in Java's order, and the blockPathWeight pick (animals use animal_get_block_path_weight, hostiles the 0.5 - brightness light weight)

members.name: RandomPositionGenerator
members.note: n/a: a static-only class; nothing in oracle/src constructs it (no new RandomPositionGenerator())

notes: The blockPathWeight dispatch in random_target_block covers the animal kinds and the zombie-through-spider, witch and pigman light weight; the squid, bat, ghast, blaze, slime and enderman kinds fall through with weight 0.0, which matches the Java defaults only where those kinds never call the generator.
